title: Concept: Possible a Sumo Logic token literal assigned to SUMOLOGIC_TOKEN in source
description: a Sumo Logic token literal assigned to SUMOLOGIC_TOKEN committed in source is a bearer credential: every reader can call the provider with the token's scopes until it is revoked. Revocation, not deletion of the file, is what ends the exposure.
applicability: Source, CI configuration, deployment manifests and notebooks that may embed a Sumo Logic token literal assigned to SUMOLOGIC_TOKEN.
risk: API access with the token's scopes, including data read/write or infrastructure changes; HIGH severity.
